CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  NOTICE N2M26-14

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE ALHAMBRA HOUSING AND COMMUNITY
  DEVELOPMENT CITIZEN ADVISORY COMMITTEE

  TUESDAY, February 3, 2026
  6:30 PM

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a special meeting of the Alhambra Housing and
Community Development Citizen Advisory (HCDA) Committee will be held on
Tuesday, February 3, 2026, commencing at 6:30 pm, at Alhambra City Hall,
Conference Room A, 2nd Floor, 111 South First Street, Alhambra CA, pursuant to
the order of the Chairman of the HCDA Committee, the Alhambra City Charter, the
Alhambra Municipal Code, and Section 54596 of the Government Code of the State
of California.

ESTEBAN ALVAREZ, MANAGEMENT ANALYST
HCDA COMMITTEE SECRETARY

Dated: January 29, 2026
Notice No: N2M26-14
   AGENDA

HOUSING AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT CITIZEN ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  TUESDAY, February 3, 2026, 6:30 PM

  REGULAR MEETING
  ALHAMBRA CITY HALL
  CONFERENCE ROOM A
  111 SOUTH FIRST STREET
  ALHAMBRA, CA 91801

 1. ROLL CALL:
  Lewis McCammon  Yvette Cardenas
  Andrea Giese  Renee-Marie Alvarez
  Manuel Armas

 2. PROGRESS REPORTS - Attached for the Committee’s review are copies of
  the Progress Reports for those programs utilizing Community Development
  Block Grant and HOME Funds. All figures indicate the progress made and
  services rendered to date for FY 2025-2026.

  a. Parks and Recreation: Senior Case Management
  i. Case Management Clients Served: 82
  ii. Volunteer Hours of assistance donated: 49
  iii. Meals delivered: 2515
  iv. Telephone calls made: 561
  b. Community Development: Code Enforcement
  i. Total number of complaints investigated: 346
  ii. Number of complaints identified as Health and Safety: 31
  iii. Number of referrals to the Housing Dept programs: 2
  c. Community Development: Housing Rights Center
  i. Number of clients served (approximately): 185
  ii. A variety of issues were discussed including evictions, security
  deposits, rent increases, repairs, contract questions, etc.
  d. Community Development: Home Improvement Programs
  i. HOME Major Rehabilitation: 4 in progress, 2 completed, 0
  cancelled
  ii. CDBG Minor Rehabilitation: 4 in progress, 2 completed, 0
  cancelled

  Recommended Action: Receive and file informational reports.

 3. 2026-2027 ANNUAL ACTION PLAN PROGRAM PREPARATION

  Each year, in preparation for the Annual Action Plan, staff presents the
  current and possible new programs to receive Community Development
   Block Grant or HOME funds in the coming program year. This gives the
  Housing and Community Development Act Citizen's Advisory Committee and
  the community an opportunity to see the programs offered by the City of
  Alhambra and preview any new or proposed projects/programs being
  considered for funding.

  Recommended Action:
  No recommended action required. This is a session to review requirements
  and submit considerations in preparation of the DRAFT 2026-2027 Annual
  Action Plan.

  4. STAFF UPDATES

  Discussion from the Staff Members of any item(s) not specified on the
  agenda. Items discussed must pertain the business of the HCDA Citizen
  Advisory Committee.

  5. COMMENTS FROM THE AUDIENCE

  Discussion from the public of any items not specified on the agenda.
  Comments must pertain to the business of the HCDA Citizen Advisory
  Committee. Public comments pertaining to the HCDA Citizen Advisory
  Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete a speak card prior to the meeting and
  submit the card to the Committee’s Secretary.

  6. COMMENTS AND CONCERNS FROM THE COMMITTEE

  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the
  agenda. Items discussed must pertain the business of the HCDA Citizen
  Advisory Committee.

  7. ADJOURNMENT

Copies of the staff report or other written documentation relating to each item of
business described herein are on file in the Office of Management Services,
Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street, Alhambra, CA, and are available for
public inspection during regular office hours from 7:00 am to 5:30: PM, Monday
through Thursday.

Should any person have a question concerning any of the above agenda items prior
the meeting, the person may contact Esteban Alvarez in the Management Services
Department in person at City Hall or at 626.570.5012 during regular business hours.
